en: Colorized panoramic view of a historic European city nestled in a valley surrounded by green mountains. The town shows dense red‑roofed buildings, church spires, a clock tower, and a large open square or field in the foreground. At the top of the image the caption reads "Brașov" and "Vedere generală" (General view). The reverse side is a classic divided postcard back printed with "România – Cartă Postală" and address lines, plus a purple rectangular stamp impression on the left.
